title: Airport Growth, Canyonlands Protection
summary:
*   **Airport Development Progress:** Major updates on the Austin-Bergstrom International Airport project, covering construction status, schedule reviews, environmental cleanup efforts, and budget details including FAA grants.
*   **Balcones Canyonlands Conservation:** In-depth report on the Balcones Canyonlands Conservation Plan, alongside discussions in executive session regarding land acquisition crucial for its implementation.
*   **City Financial Health & Public Safety:** Review of financial performance across various city utilities and departments, coupled with a briefing on a new police grant.
